wallclock.connections_guard_obsolete: The if (!visible) return guard in Connections { target: wallClock } blocks is now redundant and must be removed from all watchfaces.

spdx_conversion.duplicate_author_rule: If the same author has two copyright entries keep only the oldest year.
spdx_conversion.multi_author_line: Expand single-line multi-author entries to one SPDX line per author each with the same year.
spdx_conversion.line_order: All FileCopyrightText lines newest to oldest, then SPDX-License-Identifier last with no blank line before it.

build_system.recipe_location: recipe/ subdirectory in the app repo (moWerk convention), or recipes-asteroid/appname/ folder in meta-asteroid-community
build_system.devtool_workspace_recipe: devtool modify <appname> places the workspace recipe at workspace/sources/<appname>/recipe/<appname>.bb — this is the app's own repo recipe/ directory checked out by devtool. Editing meta-asteroid-community has no effect during an active devtool session because the workspace layer has higher priority. devtool finish writes changes back to meta-asteroid-community and discards the workspace override.
build_system.pv_format: PV = '+git${SRCPV}' is the historical community convention but is known broken — see recipe_style_guide.json pv_git_srcpv_broken. Use an explicit linear PV = '2.x.0' in all new recipes.
build_system.srcrev: AUTOREV for development, pin to exact commit hash for releases. devtool reset <appname> is required before rebuilding from pinned SRCREV to discard any workspace source override.
build_system.resource_registration: resources.qrc must list all QML and asset files. Use alias attribute to map moved asset paths without changing QML source strings: <file alias='name.svg'>../assets/name.svg</file>
build_system.community_app_DEPENDS: Always include: qml-asteroid qttools-native qtdeclarative-native. Add qtsensors when using accelerometer, compass, or barometer sensors. Add nemo-keepalive when calling DisplayBlanking.preventBlanking. Add asteroid-generate-desktop-native when CMakeLists.txt calls generate_desktop() — this is the canonical AsteroidOS desktop file pattern. See recipe_style_guide.json desktop_file_canonical_pattern for both canonical and alternative approaches.
build_system.generate_desktop_native: asteroid-generate-desktop-native must be in DEPENDS:append when the app CMakeLists.txt calls generate_desktop(). Community recipes are NOT restricted from using generate_desktop() — they simply need this dep declared explicitly. Absence causes do_install failure: cmake cannot find appname.desktop. Confirmed: MagneFire clarification 2026-05 during asteroid-toolwatch packaging.
build_system.desktop_file_approach: The canonical AsteroidOS desktop file pattern is .desktop.template + i18n/appname.desktop.h + generate_desktop() + asteroid-generate-desktop-native in DEPENDS. A plain .desktop file with install(FILES) also works but is a divergence from canon. Full documentation in recipe_style_guide.json desktop_file_canonical_pattern.
build_system.optioncycler_title_to_text: OptionCycler property renamed from title: to text: in qml-asteroid 2.1 — a hard breaking change. Any app using title: on OptionCycler will fail to start silently with no useful console output. Callers must use text: instead.
build_system.FILES_PN: Use FILES:${PN}:append (not +=) with a leading space. Required entries: ${libdir} (covers the installed .so), /usr/share/translations/ when build_translations is active, /usr/share/icons/asteroid/appname.svg when shipping an app icon SVG.
build_system.so_file_must_be_in_FILES: ${libdir} glob must appear in FILES:${PN}:append — /usr/lib/asteroid-appname.so is NOT automatically shipped. Omitting it causes do_package QA error installed-vs-shipped on clean builds. sstate cache may mask this locally.
build_system.yocto_license_checksum: Adding a copyright line changes LIC_FILES_CHKSUM md5 — update to the new md5 printed in the do_populate_lic error.

recipe_style_guide.append_operator: Always use VAR:append = " value" (with leading space). Never use VAR += in new recipes. Applies to ALL variables: DEPENDS, FILES, RDEPENDS, SRC_URI.
recipe_style_guide.variable_order: SUMMARY, HOMEPAGE, LICENSE, LIC_FILES_CHKSUM, then SRC_URI/SRCREV/PV/S, then inherit, then DEPENDS:append, then do_install:append, then FILES:${PN}:append
recipe_style_guide.no_empty_assignments: Never set RDEPENDS or any variable to empty string — remove the line entirely
recipe_style_guide.oelint_adv: pip install oelint-adv — run on all recipes before PR. MagneFire planning CI integration for meta-asteroid-community.
recipe_style_guide.branch_main: moWerk community repos use branch=main not branch=master in SRC_URI
recipe_style_guide.full_reference: See recipe_style_guide.json for complete Yocto recipe style rules, oelint conventions, and AsteroidOS-specific packaging patterns.

qt6_llvm_clang_sysroot_conflict.summary: When meta-clang is present (pulled in by the 2.2 branch for GKI/aurora device support), clang-native and oe-core's llvm-native both install /usr/include/llvm-c/lto.h and Remarks.h into native sysroots, causing do_prepare_recipe_sysroot to abort. The fix is two lines that make clang-native satisfy all llvm-native requests: 'PROVIDES:append:pn-clang-native = " llvm-native"' and 'PREFERRED_PROVIDER_llvm-native = "clang-native"'. These are now in meta-asteroid conf/distro/asteroid.conf (merged 2026-06). The fix was previously only in conf/machine/include/hybris-gki-watch.inc (aurora-specific). Any new Qt6 build on 2.2+ with an up-to-date meta-asteroid will have this fix automatically.
qt6_llvm_clang_sysroot_conflict.affected_build_versions: AsteroidOS 2.2, meta-qt6 branch 6.11, meta-clang walnascar, oe-core walnascar
qt6_llvm_clang_sysroot_conflict.symptom: ERROR: qttools-native do_prepare_recipe_sysroot: The file /usr/include/llvm-c/lto.h is installed by both llvm-native and clang-native, aborting
qt6_llvm_clang_sysroot_conflict.root_cause: meta-clang is sourced for all 2.2 builds via prepare-build.sh (PR #344), but the llvm deduplication fix was only applied to the aurora machine config, not the distro config

podman_yocto_build_setup.summary: AsteroidOS Qt6 builds can run inside the asteroidos-toolchain Podman container on Arch Linux (Omarchy). Bind-mount the Yocto tree at /asteroid, W541 sstate at /host-sstate (ro), and downloads at /host-downloads (rw). Key local.conf settings for the P14s setup: BB_NUMBER_THREADS=14, PARALLEL_MAKE=-j8, TMPDIR=${TOPDIR}/tmp-qt6, SSTATE_DIR=/asteroid/build/sstate-cache, DL_DIR=/host-downloads, SSTATE_MIRRORS pointing at both the W541 mirror and the AsteroidOS nightly cache. Performance sweet spot: --cpus=14, PARALLEL_MAKE=-j8, nice -n 3. -j8 caps per-task parallelism to prevent OOM during simultaneous LLVM/Rust/clang compilation phases (three of these overlapping at -j14 consumed 26GB RAM on 28GB system).

yocto_sstate_aurora_masks_bugs.summary: The AsteroidOS nightly sstate cache served from release.asteroidos.org can hide build-system bugs. If a package like qttools-native was built cleanly by the CI (with a different host configuration), its sstate hash matches enough to be used from cache, bypassing the local conflict that would otherwise abort the build. This means builds that rely heavily on the nightly sstate may succeed while a clean local build on the same layer set fails. Always validate with a SSTATE_MIRRORS-only build (no nightly) when investigating new-device port build errors.

bbmask_too_aggressive_warning.summary: BBMASK on an entire recipe directory (e.g. 'meta/recipes-devtools/llvm/llvm') removes the package from the entire build graph. Other packages that depend on llvm-native (mesa -> virtual/egl-native -> llvm-native) will fail with 'Nothing PROVIDES llvm-native'. BBMASK is correct for hiding entire feature layers; it is NOT the right tool for resolving file-conflict between two providers of the same headers. Use PROVIDES + PREFERRED_PROVIDER instead.

kernel_work_shared_path.summary: In Yocto, the kernel source tree is shared across recipes via WORKDIR/git which is a symlink to build/tmp-qtX/work-shared/<machine>/kernel-source/. The symlink target uses the container-internal /asteroid path; resolve to the host path as ~/Git/asteroid/build/tmp-qtX/work-shared/<machine>/kernel-source/. This is the live patched source during do_patch. Reject files (.rej) from failed patch applications appear here and can be inspected for context mismatches. bitbake -c cleansstate virtual/kernel clears the per-recipe work dir but work-shared persists across builds — the kernel source accumulates patches from successful patch tasks.

patch_fuzz_qa_vs_insane_skip.summary: The patch-fuzz quality check fires when a kernel patch applies with context offset or fuzz. This check lives in patch.bbclass and is controlled by ERROR_QA / WARN_QA, NOT by INSANE_SKIP (which only covers insane.bbclass checks). INSANE_SKIP:linux-device += "patch-fuzz" is silently ineffective. The correct suppression during development is 'ERROR_QA:remove = "patch-fuzz"' in local.conf. The correct permanent fix is to refresh the affected patches with 'devtool modify <kernel-recipe>' followed by 'devtool finish --force-patch-refresh <kernel-recipe> <layer_path>'.

oe_core_257_systemd_freeze.summary: oe-core walnascar commit 11d583e4ff and forward (systemd 257.6) introduced a linker failure in systemd-systemctl-native. Pin oe-core to the commit just before this: 'git checkout -b local-pre-257.6 11d583e4ff^' in src/oe-core. This is a temporary workaround pending an upstream fix. The symptom is a do_compile failure in systemd-systemctl-native early in the build.

local_file_unpack_destination_varies_per.summary: Local file:// SRC_URI entries do NOT always unpack to ${WORKDIR} or even to whatever ${UNPACKDIR} the recipe appears to set — some recipes' actual unpack destination (e.g. a sources-unpack/ subdirectory) only becomes clear by reading the real do_unpack log (temp/log.do_unpack.<pid> in the recipe's work dir). Confirmed case: a do_install:append referencing ${WORKDIR}/somefile.bin failed with 'No such file' even though the file was correctly fetched, because the actual recipe's true unpack destination differed from the naive assumption. Always check the do_unpack log directly rather than assuming WORKDIR or UNPACKDIR blindly, especially when porting an install block between recipes that may set S/UNPACKDIR differently.

cleansstate_is_not_a_universal_fix.summary: When a new SRC_URI file or do_install change doesn't seem to take effect after a rebuild, the instinct to reach for 'bitbake recipe -c cleansstate' is sometimes right but is not universally the fix — confirmed real-world case where the actual root cause was an edit saved to the WRONG copy of a same-named file (an editor had a stale buffer open on a different path than the one bitbake actually parses, e.g. the synced build-tree copy vs. the source-of-truth git checkout). Before escalating to sstate theories, grep the exact file path bitbake is actually parsing (confirm via 'bitbake -e recipe | grep ^FILE=' or similar) for the content you expect to find. Also verify both the .ipk's timestamp in the deploy feed AND the actual content checksum inside packages-split/ — a bitbake task summary saying 'didn't need to be rerun' can be true while stale content is still what ultimately gets packaged, if an upstream task in the chain (e.g. do_rootfs's package selection) didn't get invalidated for an unrelated reason.

qml_asteroid_ecm_module_path.summary: qml-asteroid and other ECM/KDE-CMake AsteroidOS components must keep ${ECM_MODULE_PATH} in the CMAKE_MODULE_PATH assignment: set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${ECM_MODULE_PATH} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake). ${ECM_MODULE_PATH} is what adds ECM's kde-modules/ dir (where KDEInstallDirs.cmake lives) to the module search path.
qml_asteroid_ecm_module_path.symptom: CMake configure cannot find a module / include(KDEInstallDirs) errors 'module not found' even though extra-cmake-modules is installed.
qml_asteroid_ecm_module_path.root_cause: Removing ${ECM_MODULE_PATH} from the set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ...) line drops ECM's kde-modules/ from the search path, so include(KDEInstallDirs) has nowhere to resolve the file from.
qml_asteroid_ecm_module_path.diagnostic_note: Easy to miss: a diff can carry this set() line as UNCHANGED context (dodo's case was qml-asteroid commit 08fbdb4), so the break reads as an omission, not a visible edit. First thing to check when a KDE/ECM-based AsteroidOS build reports KDEInstallDirs 'module not found'.
qml_asteroid_ecm_module_path.confidence: confirmed - dodo hit it 2026-07, found the line himself after moWerk's hints

build_system.devtool_reset_removes_deployed_ipk: Building one app ipk via `devtool modify -n <recipe> <srctree>` then `bitbake <recipe>` writes the ipk under TMPDIR/deploy/ipk, but the trailing `devtool reset -a` cleans the workspace and its freshly-deployed ipk vanishes, so a following stage stages a STALE ipk. Copy the built ipk OUT to a persistent path BEFORE `devtool reset`. Verify freshness by mtime AND size, never a bare 'IPK OK' exists-check: a 161K Jul-26 ipk shadowed the fresh 335K one and fooled a whole beluga test round (2026-08-05). TMPDIR may be tmp-qt6 OR tmp-qt6-wf per machine; a stale ipk in the other tmpdir is a classic decoy.
build_system.launcher_qml_errors_in_full_journal: Runtime QML errors from the homescreen launcher (and booster-launched settings) land in the FULL system journal (journalctl -b), NOT journalctl --user. Grep the full journal for the face path or 'is not installed' / '.qml:' to find why a face renders blank. Confirmed beluga 2026-08-05: 'asteroid-launcher[PID]: file://.../face.qml:LINE: module ... is not installed' appears only in the full journal.
build_system.session_restart_granularity: Two restart scopes on-device: `systemctl --user restart booster-asteroid-qt6` bounces only the qt6 app booster (affects the NEXT launch of booster apps like asteroid-settings); `systemctl restart user@1000` restarts the whole ceres user session including the homescreen launcher. asteroid-settings is booster-launched (invoker --type=asteroid-qt6 /usr/lib/asteroid-settings.so; the /usr/bin entry is a ~90-byte wrapper) and its QML is qrc-compiled INTO the .so, so every QML tweak needs a full bitbake (sstate keeps the C++ warm: only qml recompile + relink). A new package providing a QML module needs the FULL session restart, not just the booster, for the running launcher to pick it up.
build_system.install_via_rig_adb_when_wifi_drops: A dev watch reachable by SSH over wifi/mDNS (e.g. 'beluga') stops resolving when it sleeps. The same device on the docking-bay rig stays reachable via USB adb by serial (belugaxl on the rig), so install/flash through the rig adb (always -s <serial>) instead of SSH, wifi-independent. opkg install and `systemctl restart user@1000` all work over `adb -s <serial> shell`.
build_system.qmlformat_ci_lint: unofficial-watchfaces (and sibling AsteroidOS repos) run a qmlformat lint in CI (MagneFire/qml-format-lint-action@v2, a 'Check QML files' step). Any added or changed .qml that qmlformat would reformat FAILS the Lint job. Run `qmlformat` on every new/changed QML before pushing and verify clean with `diff -q <f> <(qmlformat <f>)`. It enforces canonical member ordering (properties before signals before functions), blank lines between member groups, and multi-line empty function bodies. Fold the format fix into the commit that introduced the file, not a separate 'fix lint' commit. Confirmed: PR #261 (2026-08-05) failed on two fake-component stubs; qmlformat -i + amend fixed it.
build_system.qmlformat_strips_for_loop_initializers: qmlformat (Qt 6.11, 'qmlformat 1.0') SILENTLY REWRITES `for (i = 0; ...)` to `for (; ...)` when the counter was declared separately (`var i, fn`), dropping the initializer. The loop then never runs (undefined < count is false) and the change is SEMANTIC, not cosmetic. CI cannot catch it because the broken form IS qmlformat's output. Confirmed 2026-08-06: running qmlformat on asteroid-settings WallpaperPage mangled three pre-existing loops and shipped an empty wallpaper grid to the device. The declaration form `for (var i = 0; ...)` is preserved correctly - always write loops that way in QML, and diff qmlformat's output for semantic changes before committing, especially on files you did not author.
build_system.rootless_podman_cgroup_parent_lives_in_t: `--cgroup-parent=build.slice` on ROOTLESS podman places the container under the USER systemd hierarchy, so verify with `systemctl --user show build.slice -p MemoryCurrent`, not `systemctl show build.slice` (the system slice stays empty and looks like the flag failed). The podman CLI process itself remains in the invoking shell's scope - that is normal and not evidence of failure. Both a system and a user build.slice exist on the p14s with the same 21G cap. Also note `pgrep -f bitbake` matches EARLYOOM ITSELF, whose --prefer regex contains the word, so process lookups by that pattern return the wrong PID.

file_structure.convention: src/ for all QML and C++ sources + resources.qrc. assets/ for SVGs and media. recipe/ for .bb file. Root contains CMakeLists.txt, LICENSE, README.md, desktop file or desktop template, app icon SVG.
file_structure.qrc_alias_pattern: When assets live in assets/, reference from src/resources.qrc using relative path + alias so QML source strings require no changes: <file alias='ship.svg'>../assets/ship.svg</file>

qml_context_properties.pattern: C++ code can expose objects and properties to QML via QQmlContext::setContextProperty(). These become global identifiers in QML scope without import statement. Common in system components like ShutdownScreen where shutdownScreen object and shutdownMode string are exposed from C++.
qml_context_properties.example: window->setContextProperty('shutdownScreen', this); window->setContextProperty('shutdownMode', shutdownMode); — makes shutdownScreen.windowVisible and shutdownMode directly accessible in QML
qml_context_properties.sizing_pattern: When C++ creates a window with specific geometry, pass screen size as context property: window->setContextProperty('initialSize', QGuiApplication::primaryScreen()->size()); — QML root should use width: initialSize.width and height: initialSize.height instead of parent.width/parent.height

qt6_migration.glyph_cache_broken_fbo_text_cost: Adreno 2xx-6xx and Mali-4xx GPUs trigger Qt's workaround_brokenFBOReadBack (auto-detected by GL_RENDERER in qopenglcontext.cpp, and force-set fleet-wide via QT_ENABLE_GLYPH_CACHE_WORKAROUND=true). This routes the NATIVE-text glyph cache (qopengltextureglyphcache.cpp) onto a CPU path: every new glyph is rasterized on the CPU into a QImage and uploaded individually, and cache growth re-uploads on the CPU. So text-heavy scenes, transitions, cold app startup, and text scaled past the distance-field size range (which falls back to native) are CPU-bound with the GPU idle. Distance-field text avoids it (size-independent, GPU-scaled). Mitigation: keep scaled/animated text inside the distance-field range (scale transform, not font.pixelSize animation; QT_DISTANCEFIELD_DEFAULT_BASEFONTSIZE/SCALE can widen it). Confirmed on nemo (Adreno 305) from Qt 6.11 source + device.
qt6_migration.wayland_composition_tax: In-process compositor surfaces (watchface, panels, launcher grid, quickpanel, notifications) render once per frame; separate-client apps (settings, weather, etc.) render twice (app + compositor re-composite) and, on round screens, additionally pass through a per-frame CircleMaskShader FBO. Buffer sharing itself is hardware zero-copy (Qt6 WaylandEgl HW integration + /dev/ion gralloc). This fixed per-frame tax is why app-content scrolling stutters on weak SoCs while in-compositor panels stay smooth. Confirmed on nemo.
qt6_migration.audio_soundeffect_chop_and_drain: The QtMultimedia media backend plugin is NOT installed on these images, so QMediaPlayer is unavailable; only QSoundEffect/QAudioSink exists. On Qt6 QSoundEffect plays the ~256ms notification.wav chopped into fragments AND holds a persistent PulseAudio stream for the launcher's whole life (sink never suspends = standby battery drain). Routing UI sounds through ngfd's GStreamer sink (a full pipeline) plays gapless and releases the stream. Confirmed by ear on beluga.
qt6_migration.status: Active migration as of 2026-05. Qt 6.11 image confirmed booting on sparrow with all fixes in this section applied. Known blockers: GL framebuffer incomplete 0x8cd6 on MSM8226 GPU causing render stuttering, QWlExtendedSurface replacement protocol not yet implemented.
qt6_migration.mkcal_timed_support: gber/mkcal qt6 branch (246dad7) fails to compile with TIMED_SUPPORT enabled because alarmhandler.cpp calls QDateTime::toTime_t() which was removed in Qt6. Fix: add -DTIMED_SUPPORT=OFF to EXTRA_OECMAKE and remove timed from DEPENDS in mkcal_git.bb. AsteroidOS does not use Maemo timed for alarm scheduling so this is safe.
qt6_migration.highdpi_scaling: Qt6 reads the display physical size in mm from hwcomposer HAL and calculates devicePixelRatio from physical DPI vs assumed 96 logical DPI. On TicWatch Pro 2020 this produces DPR ~2.9 and QScreen::geometry() reports 110x110 instead of 320x320. The evdevtouch input plugin uses QScreen::geometry() for coordinate scaling, compressing all touch coordinates into the top-left ~34% of the screen. Rendering is unaffected (uses EGL framebuffer directly). Fix: install QT_ENABLE_HIGHDPI_SCALING=0 into /var/lib/environment/compositor/ via a .conf file sourced by the asteroid-launcher systemd EnvironmentFile. Confirmed Screen.width jumps from 110 to 320 after fix. All touch interaction restored.
qt6_migration.environment_file_path: /var/lib/environment/compositor/*.conf — sourced by asteroid-launcher.service via EnvironmentFile=-/var/lib/environment/compositor/*.conf. Drop .conf files here for compositor-scoped env vars. Install via do_install:append in asteroid-launcher_git.bb.
qt6_migration.application_p_zero_size: In Qt6 the Wayland xdg_toplevel configure handshake is asynchronous. Application_p (QQuickItem subclass) uses anchors.fill: parent in Application.qml. The parent QQuickWindow geometry arrives after QML Component.onCompleted, leaving Application_p at 0x0. This causes LayerStack to calculate sub-page x positions as depth * 0 = 0 at push() time, stacking all pages with no slide animation. Fix: override itemChange in Application_p to detect ItemSceneChange and sync size from QQuickWindow::widthChanged signal. Guard with w->width() > 0 since first ItemSceneChange fires before window is sized.
qt6_migration.gesturefilterarea_signal_signatures: GestureFilterArea C++ signals confirmed: swipeMoved(bool horizontal, qreal delta) and swipeReleased(bool horizontal, qreal velocity, bool tracing). Note tracing is LAST in swipeReleased, not first. Wrong parameter order in Qt6 arrow function syntax causes broken flick physics.
qt6_migration.screen_width_321: Qt6 reports Screen.width as 321 (not 320) in Wayland client processes on sparrow after the HiDPI fix. One-pixel discrepancy likely from Wayland output rounding. Negligible for layout but worth noting when debugging coordinate calculations.

gconf_keys.inhibit_blank_mode: Controls MCE blanking inhibit. 0 = disabled (normal blanking). 3 = stay-on (display never blanks regardless of inactivity). Must be shipped as 0 in mce/builtin-gconf.values or fresh Qt6 images boot with stay-on mode active.
gconf_keys.tklock_blank_disable: Controls MCE autoblank from lockscreen. 0 = enabled (normal). 1 = disabled (display never blanks from lockscreen). Must be shipped as 0 in mce/builtin-gconf.values.
gconf_keys.use_low_power_mode: Controls AoD (ambient display) mode. true = AoD active. false = AoD disabled. Written by Qt6 launcher on startup and also by something at runtime — exact writer unknown as of 2026-05. Toggling the AoD QuickPanel button fixes it each time.
gconf_keys.diagnostic_command: mcetool --status | grep -E 'Blank inhibit|Tklock autoblank|Low power mode'

mce_display_blanking.runtime_aod_issue: AoD display randomly reverts to black during runtime without user action. Toggling AoD in QuickPanel restores it. Something writes use_low_power_mode=false during normal operation — not only at boot. Likely a charger state or battery event triggering an MCE set_config call from somewhere in the launcher or a Nemo system service. Not yet identified. Needs dbus-monitor capture during runtime to isolate caller.

applauncher_scope_chain.description: Applauncher QML files (000-vertical, 001, 002, 003, 004, 005) are loaded dynamically as preview instances by LauncherPage in asteroid-settings. In that preview context they do not have access to MainScreen.qml properties via the QML scope chain. Qt6 scope chain is stricter than Qt5.
affected_properties: launcherColorOverride — declared as property var on MainScreen.qml:62. Applaunchers write true/false in Component.onCompleted. Qt6 fires: Error: Invalid write to global property launcherColorOverride. FlatMesh color override does not function.

grid — the PanelsGrid instance. Connections blocks in all applaunchers target grid.currentVerticalPos. Resolves correctly at runtime inside MainScreen but warns when loaded as LauncherPage preview because grid is null.
applauncher_scope_chain.correct_fix: Pass launcherColorOverride as an explicit property into the dynamically loaded component, or expose via a dedicated context property. For the Connections null target warning: guard target with null check.

sparrow.gl_framebuffer_errors: GL_FRAMEBUFFER_INCOMPLETE_ATTACHMENT (0x8cd6) fires on every render frame under Qt6 RHI. Confirmed MSM8226-specific — not present on MSM8909W or MSM8937 devices. Not fixable at QML level. Requires Qt6 RHI or EGL config fix in lipstick or hwcomposer integration. C++ fix needed. Confirmed absent on MSM8926 (nemo) too, so this is MSM8226-specific within the Adreno 305 family.

Root cause specific to Today.qml configuration, not a general Qt6 Flickable regression. Multiple fix attempts failed. Needs direct Today.qml vs working Flickable panel comparison to isolate.
